name: audioextender
description: A local macOS command-line tool that analyzes an existing track, selects strong beat-aligned phrases near the beginning and end, and exports a stereo WAV with a DJ-friendly intro and outro. The full original track remains present between the added sections.

scripts.check: node --check web/app.js && node --check web/shared-components.js && node --check web/playback.js && node --check web/music-files.js && node --check web/dj-library.js && node --check web/set-builder.js && node --check web/settings.js && node --check web/import-queue.js && node --test tests/*.test.js
